duo-green.$description: Duo Green — Primary CTAs, logos, headlines, interactive highlights — the brand's key signifier of action and identity.

sky-blue.$description: Sky Blue — Secondary outline buttons, inline text links — provides a clear, alternative interactive cue.

duo-green-light.$description: Duo Green Light — Background tints for highlighted or active states, often paired with Duo Green.

sunshine-yellow.$description: Sunshine Yellow — Used exclusively within illustrations for pops of warmth and energy.

grape-soda.$description: Grape Soda — Used exclusively within illustrations as a cool, playful accent.

bubblegum-pink.$description: Bubblegum Pink — Used exclusively within illustrations for vibrant, friendly details.

snow-white.$description: Snow White — Page backgrounds, button text, card surfaces.

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Borders for secondary buttons and dividers.

silver.$description: Silver — Placeholder text, disabled states, secondary info text.

almost-black.$description: Almost Black — Primary body and UI text.

feather.$description: Used exclusively for large, impactful headlines (H1, H2). Its extremely rounded, heavy, and slightly condensed character gives the brand its signature playful and confident voice.

din-round.$description: The workhorse font for all UI text, body copy, and buttons. The noticeably wide letter-spacing (`0.053em`) is a key trait, creating a very open and readable texture. Weight 700 is used for buttons and emphasized text.
